scope: Optional plugin SDK host compatibility; not firmware hardware acceptance
limitations: This test loaded the real installed official plugin runtime and invoked its RPC endpoints. It did not render all four views in the host browser.
The real device API returned no devices in the isolated host; populated device output remains covered by separate synthetic fixture tests.
No plugin preference was changed. Caller isolation and cancellation remain covered by separate host-runtime fixture tests.
No model request, serial access, flash operation or M5 interaction was performed in this test.
The bundled application remains dev10. No result here validates a v10 image or the M5 hardware against Studio 0.8.24.
An initial test assertion expected a synchronous mount declaration. It was corrected to accept the actual exported async mount; native uninstall restored the baseline after both attempts.
